programme.title: Vie de vet

programme.title: La grande adoption

programme.title: Cuisiner le Nord

programme.title: Partis camper

programme.title: Les trésors des autres
programme.desc: À Sturgeon Falls, Michel (drag queen et DJ) chine des vêtements et accessoires d'époque pour son personnage Jenna Seppa, tandis que Carole, retraitée passionnée de tricot, cherche de la laine de seconde main pour confectionner des tuques solidaires.

programme.title: D'un rire à l'autre

programme.title: Trait d'humour

programme.title: L'amour à 16 ans

Avec ses parents qui oublient son anniversaire, des grands-parents envahissants et un étudiant étranger sur les bras, tout est fait pour que cette journée soit inoubliable.

programme.title: Elle a tout pour elle

Pour ne pas perdre sa réputation de tombeur, Zack parie avec son meilleur ami et rival, Dean, qu'il pourrait faire de n'importe quelle fille la reine du bal de fin d'année. Dean choisit pour lui Laney, une fille que tout le monde qualifie de bizarre, peintre et franchement décalée, qui ne donne pas l'impression de s'intéresser aux garçons.

programme.title: Enceinte, ou pas

Lines are drawn as love and loyalty are tested, even among the truest friends and family, in an increasingly divided world.

programme.title: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
programme.desc: Professor Albus Dumbledore knows the powerful, dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald is moving to seize control of the wizarding world. Unable to stop him alone, he entrusts magizoologist Newt Scamander to lead an intrepid team of wizards and witches. They soon encounter an array of old and new beasts as they clash with Grindelwald's growing legion of followers.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, she must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.

programme.title: Hunting Matthew Nichols
programme.desc: Two decades after her brother mysteriously disappeared, a determined woman sets out to solve the case. When a disturbing piece of evidence is revealed, she starts to believe that he may still be alive.

programme.title: Lurker
programme.desc: A retail employee infiltrates the inner circle of an artist on the verge of stardom. As he gets closer to the budding music star, access and proximity become a matter of life and death.

programme.title: Billionaire Murders
programme.desc: Kevin Donovan reveals details of Barry and Honey Shermans' last day alive, what may have happened inside their home on Dec. 13, 2017, and reconstructs the days leading up to the discovery of their bodies.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: In 1986 paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to Pennsylvania to vanquish a demon from a family's home.

programme.title: Seeds
programme.desc: Ziggy receives her first internet influencer job offer to promote the seed and fertilizer company Nature's Oath. When her cousin calls her back to the reservation, she is compelled to fight to preserve the history of her people.

programme.title: The Grizzlie Truth
programme.desc: Superfan filmmaker Kat Jayme investigates the abrupt move of her NBA hometown team, the Vancouver Grizzlies, to Memphis in 2001. Much more than a sore spot, it's an unsolved mystery and possibly a criminal conspiracy. The investigation becomes a love letter to the worst professional sports franchise in history and an exploration into the deep roots of fandom.

programme.title: Thank God: Christmas at the Keller Ranch
programme.desc: An unexpected romance develops between a no-nonsense rancher and an injured hockey player as he undergoes equine-assisted therapy.

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realizes that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

programme.title: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
programme.desc: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally loony.

programme.title: The Land Before Time

programme.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
programme.desc: Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow, Muriel, the Christmas darling of Icicle Falls. She is now separated from her husband Rob and tries her best with her daughter.

programme.desc: Newly evicted best friends Ethan, Abi and Sam escape reality with one last unforgettable night out at a London gay club; but when long-buried tensions surface, the trio must confront whether their friendship can survive the fallout.

programme.title: It Gets Worse
programme.desc: Abi has it all: a flat with her boyfriend, a new promotion, a more adult life; but beneath the surface, cracks are beginning to show; the trio reunite at a dinner party, which forces Abi to look closer at her seemingly perfect life.

programme.desc: Anne and her estranged train-wreck of a sister, Jenny, must work together to help cover their mother's gambling debts. When Anne's beloved dog is kidnapped, they set out on a wild cross-country trek to get the cash.
